titleEnglish: The Passing of His Blessed Mother ﷺ

verses.ar: وَلَمَّا بَلَغَ صَلَّى اللّٰهُ تَعَالَى عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ أَرْبَعَ سِنِينَ خَرَجَتْ بِهِ أُمُّهُ إِلَى الْمَدِينَةِ النَّبَوِيَّةْ ۞ ثُمَّ عَادَتْ فَوَافَتْهَا بِالْأَبْوَاءِ أَوْ بِشِعْبِ الْحَجُونِ الْوَفَاةْ ۞ فَحَمَلَتْهُ حَاضِنَتُهُ أُمُّ أَيْمَنَ الْحَبَشِيَّةْ ۞ الَّتِي زَوَّجَهَا بَعْدُ مِنْ زَيْدِ بْنِ حَارِثَةَ مَوْلَاهْ
verses.tr: Wa-lammā balagha ṣalla Llāhu taʿālā ʿalayhi wa-sallama arbaʿa sinīna kharajat bihi ummuhu ilā l-Madīnati n-Nabawiyyah, thumma ʿādat fa-wāfat-hā bi-l-Abwā'i aw bi-shiʿbi l-Ḥajūni l-wafāh, fa-ḥamalat-hu ḥāḍinatuhu Ummu Aymana l-Ḥabashiyyah, allatī zawwajahā baʿdu min Zaydi-bni Ḥārithata mawlāh.
verses.en: When he, may Allah Most High send prayers and peace upon him, reached four years of age, his mother took him to al-Madinah al-Nabawiyyah. Then, on her return, death overtook her at al-Abwa, or, according to another account, in the valley of al-Hajun. His nurse, Umm Ayman the Abyssinian, then took him into her care. He later married her to his freedman, Zayd ibn Harithah.

verses.ar: وَأَدْخَلَتْهُ عَلٰى جَدِّهِ عَبْدِ الْمُطَّلِبِ فَضَمَّهُ إِلَيْهِ وَرَقَّ لَهُ وَأَعْلَى رُقِيَّهْ ۞ وَقَالَ إِنَّ لِابْنِي هَذَا لَشَأْنًا عَظِيمًا فَبَخٍ بَخٍ لِمَنْ وَقَّرَهُ وَوَالَاهْ ۞ وَلَمْ تَشْكُ فِي صِبَاهُ جُوعًا وَلَا عَطَشًا قَطُّ نَفْسُهُ الْأَبِيَّةْ ۞ وَكَثِيرًا مَا غَدَا فَاغْتَذَى بِمَاءِ زَمْزَمَ فَأَشْبَعَهُ وَأَرْوَاهْ
verses.tr: Wa-adkhalat-hu ʿalā jaddihi ʿAbdi l-Muṭṭalibi fa-ḍammahu ilayhi wa-raqqa lahu wa-aʿlā ruqiyyah, wa-qāla inna li-bnī hādhā la-sha'nan ʿaẓīman fa-bakhin bakhin li-man waqqarahu wa-wālāh, wa-lam tashku fī ṣibāhu jūʿan wa-lā ʿaṭashan qaṭṭu nafsuhu l-abiyyah, wa-kathīran mā ghadā fa-ghtadhā bi-mā'i Zamzama fa-ashbaʿahu wa-arwāh.
verses.en: And she brought him to his grandfather Abd al-Muttalib, who embraced him, showed him tenderness, and held him in the highest regard. He said, “Indeed, this son of mine shall have a momentous destiny. How blessed, how blessed is the one who honours him and is devoted to him.” During his childhood, his noble soul never complained of hunger or thirst. Often, he would begin his day by taking nourishment from the water of Zamzam, and it would satisfy his hunger and quench his thirst.

verses.ar: وَلَمَّا أُنِيخَتْ بِفِنَاءِ جَدِّهِ عَبْدِ الْمُطَّلِبِ مَطَايَا الْمَنِيَّةْ ۞ كَفَلَهُ عَمُّهُ أَبُو طَالِبٍ شَقِيقُ أَبِيهِ عَبْدِ اللّٰهْ ۞ فَقَامَ بِكَفَالَتِهِ بِعَزْمٍ قَوِيٍّ وَهِمَّةٍ وَحَمِيَّةْ ۞ وَقَدَّمَهُ عَلٰى النَّفْسِ وَالْبَنِينَ وَرَبَّاهْ
verses.tr: Wa-lammā unīkhat bi-finā'i jaddihi ʿAbdi l-Muṭṭalibi maṭāya l-maniyyah, kafalahu ʿammuhu Abū Ṭālibin shaqīqu abīhi ʿAbdi Llāh, fa-qāma bi-kafālatihi bi-ʿazmin qawiyyin wa-himmatin wa-ḥamiyyah, wa-qaddamahu ʿalā n-nafsi wa-l-banīna wa-rabbāh.
verses.en: When the steeds of death knelt at the dwelling of his grandfather Abd al-Muttalib, his uncle Abu Talib, the full brother of his father Abd Allah, took him into his care. He cared for him with firm resolve, determination, and protective devotion, placing him before himself and his own children and raising him.

verses.ar: وَلَمَّا بَلَغَ اثْنَتَيْ عَشْرَةَ سَنَةً رَحَلَ بِهِ عَمُّهُ إِلَى الْبِلَادِ الشَّامِيَّةْ ۞ وَعَرَفَهُ الرَّاهِبُ بَحِيرَا بِمَا حَازَهُ مِنْ وَصْفِ النُّبُوَّةِ وَحَوَاهْ ۞ وَقَالَ: إِنِّي أَرَاهُ سَيِّدَ الْعَالَمِينَ وَرَسُولَ اللّٰهِ وَنَبِيَّهْ ۞ وَقَدْ سَجَدَ لَهُ الشَّجَرُ وَالْحَجَرُ وَلَا يَسْجُدَانِ إِلَّا لِنَبِيٍّ أَوَّاهْ ۞ وَإِنَّا لَنَجِدُ نَعْتَهُ فِي الْكُتُبِ الْقَدِيمَةِ السَّمَاوِيَّةْ
verses.tr: Wa-lammā balagha-thnatay ʿashrata sanatan raḥala bihi ʿammuhu ilā l-bilādi sh-Shāmiyyah, wa-ʿarafahu r-rāhibu Baḥīrā bi-mā ḥāzahu min waṣfi n-nubuwwati wa-ḥawāh, wa-qāla: innī arāhu sayyida l-ʿālamīna wa-rasūla Llāhi wa-nabiyyah, wa-qad sajada lahu sh-shajaru wa-l-ḥajaru wa-lā yasjudāni illā li-nabiyyin awwāh, wa-innā lanajidu naʿtahu fī l-kutubi l-qadīmati s-samāwiyyah.
verses.en: When he reached twelve years of age, his uncle journeyed with him to the lands of al-Sham, and the monk Bahira recognised him by the signs of Prophethood that he possessed and embodied, and said, “Indeed, I see him as the Master of the Worlds, the Messenger of Allah, and His Prophet. The trees and stones have prostrated before him, and they do not prostrate except before a deeply devout prophet. Indeed, we find his description in the ancient heavenly scriptures.”

verses.ar: وَبَيْنَ كَتِفَيْهِ خَاتَمُ النُّبُوَّةِ قَدْ عَمَّهُ النُّورُ وَعَلَاهْ ۞ وَأَمَرَ عَمَّهُ بِرَدِّهِ إِلَى مَكَّةَ تَخَوُّفًا عَلَيْهِ مِنْ أَهْلِ دِينِ الْيَهُودِيَّةْ ۞ فَرَجَعَ بِهِ وَلَمْ يُجَاوِزْ مِنَ الشَّامِ الْمُقَدَّسِ بُصْرَاهْ
verses.tr: Wa-bayna katifayhi khātamu n-nubuwwati qad ʿammahu n-nūru wa-ʿalāh, wa-amara ʿammahu bi-raddihi ilā Makkata takhawwufan ʿalayhi min ahli dīni l-yahūdiyyah, fa-rajaʿa bihi wa-lam yujāwiz mina sh-Shāmi l-muqaddasi Buṣrāh.
verses.en: And between his shoulders was the Seal of Prophethood, enveloped and covered by light. Fearing for him from the followers of Judaism, the monk instructed his uncle to return him to Makkah. So he returned with him and did not proceed beyond Busra into the blessed lands of al-Sham.

verses.ar:
عَطِّرِ اللّٰهُمَّ قَبْرَهُ الْكَرِيمَ بِعَرْفٍ شَذِيٍّ مِنْ صَلَاةٍ وَتَسْلِيمٍ
اللّٰهُمَّ صَلِّ وَسَلِّمْ وَبَارِكْ عَلَيْهِ
verses.tr:
ʿAṭṭiri Llāhumma qabrahu l-karīma bi-ʿarfin shadhiyyin min ṣalātin wa-taslīmin.
Allāhumma ṣalli wa-sallim wa-bārik ʿalayhi.
verses.en:
O Allah, perfume his noble grave with a fragrant scent of prayers and peace.
O Allah, send prayers, peace, and blessings upon him.
